We have applied first template 324324, got precursors: ('Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1', 'Nc1ccccc1N'). So product is original target, precursors are a sulfonyl aryl with a carboxylic acid side chain and an aniline (Nc1ccccc1N). Next apply template 1914396 to the first precursor (the sulfonyl aryl with carboxylic acid). The result gave precursors: ('Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1', 'O=C(O)CC(=O)O'). So now we have three molecules: first is aryl sulfonyl with aldehyde (C=O) on second phenyl, second is O=C(O)CC(=O)O (malonic acid?). Actually O=C(O)CC(=O)O is succinic acid? It's HOOC-CH2-COOH. Good.

Now need third template 733 to apply to something to get final precursors. Likely apply to the aldehyde-containing sulfonyl aryl to convert aldehyde to something? Let's check if template 733 matches the first precursor 'Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1'. Use check.
